doc: Two frames are blended linearly by progress. Integer implementation: a = round(progress×255), out = (from×(255−a) + to×a + 127) / 255 (u8 truncating division), applied per channel on premultiplied sRGB. a = 0 and a = 255 are byte-identical to from / to. `progress` is the closed interval [0,1], and the endpoints must be exact, so it cannot be written as a float interpolation followed by rounding.
